correctness.rationale: The matrix identities square-one and commutativity are exact; nonzero B forces A=C=0; B=0 reduces to four-dimensional split quadratic form. Rank-one matrix arguments give (q+1)^2 singular projective points and 2(q+1) singular planes, yielding a proved all-arity spanning-tuple count. Every abstract elementary abelian subgroup is contained in H or a K_W, and only W0 is subsumed. Standalone exact finite checks q=2,4 corroborate but do not establish infinite parameters.
